Collect our special limited-edition stickers this October! The Urban Indian Center of Salt Lake is excited to release our Legacy Mural Sticker Collection for October 2026.

How to Claim Your Sticker

Be a registered client (or live in the same household as a registered client).

Attend any UICSL event or program.

Receive your sticker after completing your visit.

Important Details

Availability: Monthly designs are only available during their release month. Make sure to grab yours this October!

Website: www.uicsl
